data: In which span of years were most of the Imagist poems published?

The scatter plot shows the distribution of publication years for three groups of poems: 19th century poems (circles), Imagist poems (triangles), and contemporary poems (dots). The x-axis represents the publication year, and the y-axis represents the arousal score.

To determine the span of years in which most of the Imagist poems were published, we need to focus on the Imagist data points (triangles). The caption mentions that the Imagist movement occurred after 1900, and the data points for Imagist poems are concentrated around this time period.

By examining the scatter plot, we can see that the majority of Imagist poems are clustered between approximately 1900 and 1920. This indicates that most of the Imagist poems were published during this span of years.
